text:
When my life is,

all clear and light

like a good river

that runs joyfully

to the sea,

to the unknown sea

that waits

full of sun and song.


And when spring bursts

in my heart

you will be, my life,

the inspiration

of my new poem.


A song of peace and love

to the rhythm of the blood

that runs through the veins.

A song of love and peace.

Only of sweet things and words.


Meanwhile,

meanwhile, keep the golden key

of my verses

among your jewels.

Keep it and wait.

translation.title: When My Life Is
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the river-to-sea future and the golden key entrusted to the beloved.
